rationale: Detuned base PI for 25s delay margin but kept nominal speed via error-dependent boost, plus online delay/stuck detection. Histories of u/yf over 40s estimate Td: if |du|>0.08 over 25s produces |dy|<0.03 then delay_score->1. If |e|>0.10 but 10s slope <0.004 then stuck->freeze integrator and clamp u to FF+/- window. Gains interpolate KP 0.75->0.28, TI 16->36s, I-auth 0.22->0.12, slew 0.5->0.06 /s. This holds u ~0.55-0.6 and waits out the 25s deadtime instead of winding to saturation and limit-cycling, while d~0 restores near-original aggressive control for nominal plant.
